title: Reaction-Diffusion System Approximation to the Fast Diffusion Equation
summary: This paper proposes a novel reaction-diffusion system approximation tailored for singular diffusion problems, typified by the fast diffusion equation. While such approximation methods have been successfully applied to degenerate parabolic equations, their extension to singular diffusion-where the diffusion coefficient diverges at low densities-has remained unexplored. To address this, we construct an approximating semilinear system characterized by a reaction relaxation parameter and a time-derivative regularizing parameter.
